title: I integrated claude into my trading setup to analyse my trades and the results are pretty decent tbh
author: future_trader2483
selftext:
Core Idea : Alright so what i essentially did is that Ai fetches the Market data for you  and then splits into 2 core paths :

1. Ai Vision Coach  
2. A Chart Replay Engine

The very foundation lies in the Vision coach which is actually claude integrated , so what it does is , the Ai coach reads the frozen chart for structures like order blocks , liquidity sweeps , fair value gaps , fibonacci retracements , trendlines , HH ,LL , no matter what startegy you trade , the Ai coach marks all these structures on your chart which saves you a ton of time and also its insanely accurate . Its called tradexis

Alongside this , the Ai coach is essentially trained on your previously repeated patterns , so evey time you are trading the same futures or forex or commodity it reminds you of what went right or wrong with the last trade on that same thing you were trading.( depending upon whether that last trade was profitable or not) .

The chart replay engine actually helps you backtest extensively powered by the Ai coach helping you identify the setups and leaks in the market . 

Also it has a prop firm drawdown tracker for the ones trading funded accounts in accordance with FTMO , apex and other top prop firms drawdown rules so it lets you backtest with this tracker integrated into the system .

This is not an automated trading bot , its like an Ai living in your charting system helping you identify structures and fit your trading setups accordingly saving you time and hassle for FREE , i made it for myself to show as a project in my college semester practical  ( i am pursuing CS at Stevens ) but since if it can help out others then you def give it a shot . 

No hallucinated math and No    
blind automation.

comments.author: tweetpilot
comments.body:
The level of cap in this post and your comments is wild bro.

You keep claiming you built this "for $0" and "for the community" as a CS semester project at stevens, yet you bought a domain, set up a whole SaaS landing page with a "START FREE" button **(the standard freemium hook)**, and switch between "we have the best in class UI" and "there is no team here, it’s just me... well, wait for it: me and a classmate."

Pick an effin story bruv. Either its just you or its a TEAM = classmate + you!

And taht lame cop-out about why you cant open-source it??

 Claiming you cant open-source a student project because it would "expose APIs and security architecture" tells everyone all they need to know. Stop the BS. API keys belong in .env files, not hardcoded into your repo!! 

# Are you really paying $80k a year at Stevens for them to skip basic Git security, or did that lecture cost extra?

 If your "security architecture" falls apart the second someone looks at the code, that’s not security!

Then you claim Claude Vision reads frozen chart screenshots for Fibs, Order Blocks, Liquidity Sweeps, and FVGs with "insanely accurate" precision and "no hallucinated math." Vision models literally cannot do pixel-exact spatial geometry on static images. Real market structure analysis requires raw OHLC price data, not an image model guessing pixels on a JPEG screenshot.

So you and your classmate TEAMED UP (oh sorry, you aren't a team as you already pointed out) and built a custom, ground-up WebGL charting engine from scratch in a couple months for a class project that beats TradingView?? You cant be fucking serious lol.

Its fine to plug your SaaS, but at least have the self-respect to own the hustle instead of hiding behind a fake "aw shucks, humble student" story.
